## Learning outcomes

By the end of the session, learners should be able to:
1. Explain the difference between a scripted phrase matcher and a generative AI model.
2. Trace a submitted message through the React component structure.
3. Describe ordered matching and why rule precedence matters.
4. Run the test suite and add a regression test.
